text: This report recommends appointment of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Chair, Vice-Chair, Treasurer, and Corporate Secretary.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Appointed the following Officers of the Corporation to hold office at the pleasure of the Board for one year, or until their successors are appointed: - Vice Chair: Councillor Shelley Carroll - Corporate Secretary: Graysanne Bedell - Treasurer: Kimberly Marshall 2. Appointed Parminder Sandhu as Chair of the Board of Directors for a term of four years or until a successor is appointed.
